If $T_0 = T_1$, linear interpolation yields $T_0$ [S1].

The evidence provides the formula for linear interpolation: $T_t = T_0 · exp(log(T_0^{-1} · T_1) * (t/τ))$. If $T_0 = T_1$, then $T_0^{-1} · T_1 = I$ (identity). The logarithm of the identity matrix is the zero vector. The exponential of the zero vector is the identity matrix. Therefore, $T_t = T_0 · I = T_0$. Thus, the claim is mathematically supported by the provided formula.
